name: avanik-travel
description: Avanik Travel WordPress theme development workspace

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['wordpress/avanik/assets/css/main.css','wordpress/avanik/assets/css/main.css.map','wordpress/avanik/assets/js/main.js','wordpress/avanik/assets/js/main.js.map']) { try { fs.rmSync(p,{force:true}); } catch(e) {} }"
